title: Jesus... Why Does Everyone Look Ahead Of Me?

bible.text: Each one should test their own actions. Then they can take pride in themselves alone, without comparing themselves to someone else.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... can I be honest? I'm tired of pretending I'm happy for everyone. 😭

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Every time I open my phone, someone is getting the job I wanted, travelling somewhere I've dreamed of, getting married... and I'm still stuck in the same place.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: And what happens inside you when you see their lives?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I smile for them. I even say congratulations. Then I put my phone down and wonder... "What's wrong with me?"

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Sometimes I cry because I feel like everyone is moving forward except me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're carrying a timeline I never gave you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But Jesus... what if I never get what they have?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then their life is still theirs, and your life is still yours. You don't have to become someone else to prove that your life has value.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I think I've spent so much time watching everyone else live... that I forgot to live my own life.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That's what comparison does. It makes you stare at someone else's chapter until you start hating your own. Put the phone down. Look at Me. Your story isn't over. 🤍

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You were never asked to compete with someone else's journey. Walk the road God gave you, one step at a time.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Be brutally honest 👀 — have you ever congratulated someone and then cried when you got home? Drop a 🫠 if you've felt this.
